''If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it.'' |} In this quest you first have to locate the [[Lab technician body|lab scientist]] in the main building of the TerraGroup building complex. He can be found in a hallway behind the big TerraGroup sign in the entrance hall, buried under rubble. Inside the body, a [[TerraGroup science office key]] can be found which unlocks office no. 4 on the second floor. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid, but can be taken by other players.
